description: This Java class 'StartupControlPanel' manages high-level startup and shutdown operations for the OFBiz server, including configuration initialization, container loading, and graceful termination.

classes.name: StartupControlPanel
classes.description: A final class responsible for orchestrating the startup, shutdown, and configuration loading procedures for the OFBiz server.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes OFBiz by setting system properties and creating configuration object based on user commands.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Executes the startup sequence, including logging, container loading, and optionally adding shutdown hooks or exiting after load.

methods.name: fullyTerminateSystem
methods.description: Handles fatal startup exceptions by printing the stack trace and terminating the JVM with an error code.

methods.name: shutdownServer
methods.description: Gracefully stops the server by unloading containers and updating server state atomically.

methods.name: loadGlobalOfbizSystemProperties
methods.description: Loads system properties from a specified properties file into the JVM's system properties.

methods.name: createLogDirectoryIfMissing
methods.description: Creates the log directory if it does not already exist.

methods.name: loadContainers
methods.description: Loads server containers and transitions server state to 'RUNNING'.
